purpose: Review a finite Campaign125 catalog against all 149 complete definitions, source history and point-in-time requirements without reading a Campaign125 source row or research value.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: static_company_employee_or_registered_capital_intensity
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The current company profile is a static latest-state table without effective-date history. Employees, management and registered capital cannot be reconstructed point-in-time for 2019-2023 from the documented fields, so using the present row would leak later state into earlier folds.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: northbound_holding_ratio_state_or_change
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The official documentation states that exchanges stopped daily northbound publication from 2024-08-20 and moved to quarterly disclosure. A single fixed daily definition cannot cover the required 2019-2025 campaign without a source-frequency regime change, imputation or window rescue.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: important_holder_trade_direction_or_intensity
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Important-holder increase/decrease direction, volume, ratio and freshness are already present in the complete historical event frontier. Selecting a new holder subtype, age, aggregation or direction after those results would be a terminal field/operator retry, not a new information state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: block_trade_discount_pressure_or_counterparty_state
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: Tushare block_trade or existing accepted block-trade snapshot
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Block-trade premium, turnover, count and freshness have already been historically exposed and used. Counterparty text was deliberately excluded from the prior numeric contract; adding it or changing the three-day event operator after outcomes would be a source-field and text-classification rescue.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: financial_report_schedule_revision_or_actual_delay
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The disclosure-promptness branch is terminal after its one-shot source failure. Its binding explicitly forbids adding actual_date, parsing modify_date, changing the date anchor, direction or event age, or issuing another request.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: additional_intraday_ohlcv_amount_transform_or_complete_library_combination
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: accepted local minute and daily roots
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The remaining proposed entropy, first-passage, profile, state-transition, rolling-baseline and fitted-combination variants reuse terminal OHLCV/amount operators or exposed complete-library components. They do not identify a new economic state and would increase multiplicity through post-exposure recombination.

next_frontier_without_formula_or_directi.economic_question: Can a separately accepted, historically versioned point-in-time source identify a new ownership, order-flow, governance or event state with a stable 2019-2025 publication contract?
